headlines.title: GOP Sen. Lisa Murkowski comes out against Todd Blanche for AG, putting nomination in jeopardy
headlines.description: GOP Sen. Lisa Murkowski says she will vote against Todd Blanche for AG, putting confirmation in jeopardy

headlines.title: Mitch McConnell Leaves Rehab to Continue Recovery at Home
headlines.description: Kentucky Sen. Mitch McConnell says he’s been discharged from a rehabilitation center and will continue his recovery at home. The 84-year-old Republican had been away for nearly two months after falling at his home and being hospitalized.

headlines.title: Trump Targets 'Birth Tourism' With Two New Executive Orders
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is once again trying to restrict birthright citizenship, signing two executive orders that aim to crack down on “birth tourism.” The Supreme Court already blocked a previous effort by the president to limit the constitutional right and critics believe this order will meet the same fate. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Andy Ogles defeated in Tennessee House GOP primary, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles lost despite having President Trump’s endorsement, NBC News projects. Former state Agriculture Commissioner Charlie Hatcher will be the GOP nominee.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary in Tennessee
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee has lost his Republican primary, NBC News projects, falling to a former state official in a primary season that has seen an unusually high number of incumbents lose renomination.

headlines.title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn wins the Republican primary for governor of Tennessee
headlines.description: Blackburn, a longtime Trump ally, defeated Rep. John Rose for the nomination, NBC News projects, after the president decided not to endorse in the race.

headlines.title: What the left’s Michigan breakthrough does — and doesn’t — mean: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Jonathan Allen digs into the lessons progressives can take away from Abdul El-Sayed’s victory.

headlines.title: Ohio Rep. Max Miller faces a growing number of calls to resign from fellow Republicans
headlines.description: Miller, who is running for re-election, has denied abusing his ex-wife, Emily Moreno, who is the daughter of Sen. Bernie Moreno of Ohio.

headlines.title: IRS workers group joins Jan. 6 ‘slush fund’ suit, seeking to block Trump audit carve-out
headlines.description: Career IRS employees joined the weaponization fund lawsuit, challenging a carve-out that would give him and members of his family immunity from certain tax audits.

headlines.title: Sen. Mitch McConnell discharged from rehab center following hospitalization in mid-June
headlines.description: The Republican senator said he would continue to work from home and didn’t provide a timeline for his Senate return.

headlines.title: Senators vote to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress for invoking the Fifth
headlines.description: Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions over 100 times during last week’s hearing, angering Republican lawmakers who have targeted him for years.
